release_limit: This local review does not replace final source freeze review, clean installed wheel and separate PowerShell native proof, accepted one and three gameweek numerical checks, full repository gates or exact final commit CI. resolved_findings.initial_observation: Actual getpass fallback warned and the injected store received one write.
resolved_findings.issue: Hidden prompt allowed the stdlib echo fallback and stored its returned value.
resolved_findings.resolution: GetPassWarning becomes a typed secure input refusal before fallback input can be read or stored.

resolved_findings.issue: Usage errors echoed unexpected positional values and unknown option names.
resolved_findings.resolution: Credential command and group parser adapters discard raw usage exception graphs and return fixed syntax guidance.

resolved_findings.issue: Direct FPL error isolation copied arbitrary typed transport codes and messages into public errors.
resolved_findings.resolution: The raw boundary whitelists public codes and maps each to fixed public text; unknown typed and untyped errors become a fixed source failure.

resolved_integration_advisories.issue: Direct FPL raw error isolation initially lost acquisition authorization reason codes.
resolved_integration_advisories.resolution: One shared AuthorizationError type is reexported by the old dashboard module. Raw failures become only allowlisted constant fields. The public client raises a fresh shared error after the secret frame returns. Known expiry and budget reasons survive; unknown codes and arbitrary input state become fixed unavailable and blocked.

resolved_integration_advisories.issue: The fixed error mapper initially narrowed an accepted transient source retry flag.
resolved_integration_advisories.resolution: Known SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE preserves only the exact boolean true retry flag; arbitrary truthy objects and raw messages are discarded.

scope: CP1 code and injected credential security review before final installed acceptance

testing.harness_history: While appending authorization tests, the reviewer temporarily inserted a new function inside an existing try block. Collection failed once; moving the appended function after the existing finally restored valid syntax. No application change resulted. The final full sixty nine case run passed.
testing.initial_failure_history: Twelve actual failures covered terminal fallback, parser disclosure and typed transport disclosure. An earlier exploratory run also had two invalid reviewer quota fixtures; correcting used credits to two made those cases valid. A reused pytest temporary directory hit Windows cleanup permissions; fresh owned directories and disabled cache resolved that test harness issue.

verified: Constructors keep vault and credential resolution lazy; native integration import is confined to explicit operations.
Windows AUTO resolves the exact vault slot only; explicit environment selection is required. Missing or broken vault does not fall back to a present environment value.
Linux AUTO retains the accepted systemd credential file and ignores raw environment credentials.
Odds ASCII bounds and UTF16LE stored lengths are enforced; malformed surrogate, BOM, odd, short and oversized blobs fail closed.
FPL expiry metadata is checked before blob decode; exact expiry, pacing and retry waits block the next authenticated send. Oversize replacement preserves the previous record.
Authorization guard and FPL request exhaustion reject before resolving credentials. Odds missing quota, exhausted quota and blocked rights reject before provider or client factory.
Injected native missing, unavailable logon and access denied errors produce fixed nonrevealing codes and detached exception graphs.
Native adapter uses exact target and Generic type, same-user local-machine persistence, flags zero and a Python string for the pinned UTF16 facade.

Eight actual separate processes used only an owned LOCALAPPDATA lock directory: one creator, seven existing refusals. A competing process timed out safely; terminating the holder released the native byte lock. The one-byte nonsensitive lock file remains.
No production vault target, real credential, provider endpoint or database was accessed. No tracked implementation file was edited by this reviewer.

Six additional authorization cases check before lookup and after lookup transport boundaries. Known expiry and budget codes survive; unknown code and state canaries cannot escape. Exception contexts and causes remain detached.
Three additional source failure cases prove strict boolean retry flag preservation while text remains fixed.

Actual pulse CLI one and three gameweek missing and unregistered approval paths cannot call the native adapter or read sensitive credential environment variables. Shared console receives only the exact authorization identifier, manager, horizon and publication callbacks; no credential, caller deadline, quota, source or code hash bypass exists.
Pulse catches even a hostile injected authorization error using fixed public text. A shared console publication callback is the only report route.
Narrow ignore exceptions expose only the code and test credential module paths for Git and packaging. This does not unignore any secret store or credential value path.
